summary.intent: Capture implementation decisions for Phase 20 (Vault Migration) via discuss-phase, then research and plan the phase using the GSD workflow.
summary.outcome: CONTEXT.md was written and committed on a feature branch, research (RESEARCH.md) and validation strategy (VALIDATION.md) were generated, and the planner agent was spawned to create PLAN.md files.

repo: Vault blob v2 format is defined as: 0x02 | uint16 key_length | ECIES_key | AES_GCM_metadata — this is the target storage format that removes rootFolderKey from the DB
encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey are the two DB columns being migrated; both are NULLed after v2 blob is confirmed written
IPNS key is HKDF-derivable from master key — the stored copy in encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey is therefore redundant and safe to remove
Migration trigger is next login (lazy), not a batch job or forced migration for dormant accounts
Read strategy is phased: migrated users (migratedAt set) use IPFS-first with silent DB fallback; unmigrated users use DB directly
Kubo performance is currently the main IPFS bottleneck; infra fixes are in-flight, which is why silent DB fallback is the initial safety net before transitioning to IPFS-only retry-then-error

Phase 18 added server-side Prometheus histograms for IPNS resolve/publish; Phase 22 will add end-to-end login-to-vault journey timing — Phase 20 can rely on these rather than capturing its own baselines
Blob v2 write logic lives in @cipherbox/core (TypeScript) with a Rust equivalent in the desktop app — both web and desktop write v2 on root folder publish
Recovery tool also needs to be updated to parse v2 blob format
API will continue accepting encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey on init but ignore it, allowing gradual client deprecation

code.finding: Contains encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey columns — both targeted for NULL after migration
Vault initialization logic in @cipherbox/core — blob v2 write logic should be added here
Vault type definitions — VaultBlob type will need updating for v2 format
Server-side vault service — migration trigger and migratedAt stamping logic goes here
Web client vault store — needs v2 blob write on root folder publish
Desktop Rust vault commands — confirmed IPNS key is HKDF-derivable; needs Rust equivalent of blob v2 write logic

workflow: GSD discuss-phase loads prior CONTEXT.md files from earlier phases to avoid re-asking already-decided questions — carrying forward decisions like network-first IPNS and the five-package SDK architecture
commit signing via 1Password requires an interactive terminal — subprocess git commits fail silently if the 1Pass agent notification is missed
Feature branches should be created before committing planning docs, not after — the workflow attempted to commit to main initially
The GSD workflow checks for a migratedAt flag pattern to implement per-user phased rollout — this is a standard pattern for lazy migrations
VALIDATION.md is generated from a template and filled with phase-specific frontmatter before being committed alongside RESEARCH.md

friction: 1Password commit signing failed in the subprocess — the user was AFK and missed the signing notification, requiring a manual retry
Initial commit attempted to push to main instead of a feature branch — required branch creation after the fact
The system readiness question was framed too narrowly and the user had to clarify that Kubo performance (not metrics coverage) was the real constraint
open_items: Column DROP migration for encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey — deferred until all users are confirmed migrated
IPFS-only retry-then-error mode (removing silent DB fallback) — deferred until Kubo performance fixes prove out
End-to-end login-to-vault baseline metrics — Phase 22 will add this instrumentation; Phase 20 relies on existing /metrics endpoint
Planner agent was spawned but transcript ends before PLAN.md files are confirmed complete
